label_pal_v1.title: START HERE · Spatial JSON & Model Files
label_pal_v1.note:
1. **Requires ComfyUI 0.42.1+**.
2. `models/diffusion_models/moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors`
3. `models/text_encoders/qwen3.5_9b_w4a8_gptq.safetensors` (`moss_image`)
4. `models/vae/flux2-vae_small.safetensors`

- Bounding boxes use centered pixel coordinates (`-512..+512` on `1024×1024`). Match **Resolution Selector** if you change layout bounds.

nodes.title: LabelPal · Prompting Tip

label_pal_v1.title: LITERAL JSON · Safe Braces & Layouts
label_pal_v1.note:
- Prompt Palette automatically protects complete valid JSON objects so `{...}` braces are **never** mangled as choices.
- Prefer visual cards? Enable **Fields Workspace** in **Settings → Power tools** and pick a **MOSS** layout!
